Script.name: snd
Script.script:
--[[ Search & Destroy — mob/area data layer Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31
The MUSHclient Search_and_Destroy.xml is a 360KB plugin: quest/campaign/gquest target tracking, its own runto, a target miniwindow and a self-updater. Most of the movement half of that is Mudlet's speedwalker's job, so what's ported here is the part nothing else replaces — the mob/area database and the lookups over it.
That database is also what SolaoBot's 'solbot mob <kw>' reads, which is why it lands before the rest of S&D.
Not ported (deliberately): the runto/target automation and the plugin self-updater. See PORTING.md. ]]
aard = aard or {} aard.snd = aard.snd or {}
local SD = aard.snd local U = aard.util
local ok, handle = pcall(db.create, db, "aardsnd", { mobs = { mob = "", room = "", roomid = 0, zone = "", seen_count = 0, kill_count = 0, _index = { "mob", "zone" }, _unique = { { "mob", "roomid" } }, }, area = { name = "", key = "", minlvl = 0, maxlvl = 0, lock = 0, startRoom = 0, noquest = "", vidblain = "", userKey = "", _index = { "key" }, _unique = { { "key" } }, }, keywords = { area_name = "", mob_name = "", keyword = "", _index = { "mob_name" }, _unique = { { "area_name", "mob_name" } }, }, })
SD.dbh = ok and handle or nil SD.dberr = (not ok) and tostring(handle) or nil
-- lazily resolved, same reason as Loot Tracker's: a nil here reads to every -- consumer as "S&D isn't loaded" and never recovers SD.t = setmetatable({}, { __index = function(_, k) local d = SD.dbh or (db and db.aardsnd) return d and d[k] or nil end, })
local T = SD.t
--- -- capture (off by default; the trigger is disabled until 'snd scan on') ---
-- strip the transient status flags Aardwolf prefixes -- "(flying) a casanova" local function strip_flags(m) local s = tostring(m or "") while true do local n = s:gsub("^%s*%b()%s*", "", 1) if n == s then break end s = n end return U.trim(s) end
function SD.on_scan(mob) mob = strip_flags(mob) if mob == "" then return end local roomid, room, zone = U.room() if not roomid then return end local where = db:AND(db:eq(T.mobs.mob, mob), db:eq(T.mobs.roomid, roomid)) local found = db:fetch(T.mobs, where) if found and found[1] then db:update(T.mobs, { seen_count = (found[1].seen_count or 0) + 1, room = room or "", zone = zone or "" }, where) else db:add(T.mobs, { mob = mob, room = room or "", roomid = roomid, zone = zone or "", seen_count = 1, kill_count = 0 }) end end
--- -- lookups ---
local function keyword_for(mob) local r = db:fetch(T.keywords, db:eq(T.keywords.mob_name, mob)) return r and r[1] and r[1].keyword or nil end
function SD.where(term) term = U.trim(term) if term == "" then U.warn("Usage: mobwhere <keyword>"); return end
local rows = db:fetch(T.mobs, db:like(T.mobs.mob, "%" .. term .. "%")) if not rows or #rows == 0 then U.note("No mob matching '" .. term .. "' in the S&D data.") return end
-- merge per mob name so one line covers every room it's been seen in local agg, order = {}, {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local nm = strip_flags(r.mob) local a = agg[nm] if not a then a = { name = nm, zone = r.zone or "", room = r.room or "", ids = {}, seen = {}, cnt = 0 } agg[nm] = a order[#order + 1] = nm end if r.roomid and r.roomid ~= 0 and not a.seen[r.roomid] then a.seen[r.roomid] = true a.ids[#a.ids + 1] = r.roomid end a.cnt = a.cnt + (r.seen_count or 0) end table.sort(order, function(x, y) return agg[x].cnt > agg[y].cnt end)
U.note(#order .. " mob(s) matching '" .. term .. "':") for i, nm in ipairs(order) do if i > 20 then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>... " .. (#order - 20) .. " more<r>") break end local a = agg[nm] local kw = keyword_for(nm) U.out("\n <#7aa2f7>" .. a.name .. "<r>" .. (kw and (" <#8a93a8>[" .. kw .. "]<r>") or "")) U.out("\n <#c8d0dc>" .. (a.zone ~= "" and a.zone or "?") .. " - " .. (a.room ~= "" and a.room or "?") .. "<r>") local ids = {} for j, id in ipairs(a.ids) do if j > 8 then ids[#ids + 1] = "..."; break end ids[#ids + 1] = U.rid(id) end if #ids > 0 then U.out(" <#8a93a8>rooms: " .. table.concat(ids, ",") .. "<r>") -- clickable: hand the first room to the Mudlet speedwalker U.outLink(" <#3ad07a>[go]<r>", "aard.snd.walkto(" .. U.rid(a.ids[1]) .. ")", "Speedwalk to room " .. U.rid(a.ids[1]), true) end end echo("\n") end
function SD.walkto(roomid) if not roomExists(roomid) then U.warn("Room " .. U.rid(roomid) .. " isn't in the Mudlet map. Run 'aardmap import yes' first.") return end local here = getPlayerRoom() if not here then U.warn("Mudlet doesn't know where you are yet - move a room and try again.") return end if getPath(here, roomid) then U.ok("Walking to " .. U.rid(roomid) .. " (" .. #speedWalkDir .. " steps).") doSpeedWalk() else U.warn("No path from " .. U.rid(here) .. " to " .. U.rid(roomid) .. ".") end end
local function show_area(term) term = U.trim(term):lower() local rows = db:fetch(T.area) if not rows or #rows == 0 then U.note("No area data. Run 'aard migrate' to bring it over from MUSHclient.") return end local hits = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do if term == "" or (r.name .. " " .. r.key):lower():find(term, 1, true) then hits[#hits + 1] = r end end table.sort(hits, function(a, b) return (a.minlvl or 0) < (b.minlvl or 0) end) U.note(#hits .. " area(s):") for i, r in ipairs(hits) do if i > 40 then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>... " .. (#hits - 40) .. " more<r>") break end U.out(string.format("\n <#7aa2f7>%-32s<r> <#8a93a8>%-14s L%d-%d%s<r>", r.name, r.key, r.minlvl or 0, r.maxlvl or 0, (r.startRoom or 0) > 0 and (" start " .. U.rid(r.startRoom)) or "")) end echo("\n") end
--- -- commands ---
local scan_on = false
function SD.cmd(arg) local verb, rest = U.split_verb(arg)
if verb == "" or verb == "status" then local m = db:fetch(T.mobs) or {} local a = db:fetch(T.area) or {} local k = db:fetch(T.keywords) or {} U.help("Search & Destroy data", { { "mobs", tostring(#m) }, { "areas", tostring(#a) }, { "keywords", tostring(#k) }, { "scanning", scan_on and "on" or "off" }, })
elseif verb == "mob" or verb == "where" then SD.where(rest)
elseif verb == "area" or verb == "areas" then show_area(rest)
elseif verb == "scan" then local v = U.trim(rest):lower() if v == "on" or v == "off" then scan_on = (v == "on") enableTrigger("scan mob line") if not scan_on then disableTrigger("scan mob line") end U.ok("S&D: room scanning " .. v .. ".") else U.warn("Usage: snd scan on|off") end
else U.help("Search & Destroy data", { { "snd", "row counts" }, { "snd mob <keyword>", "where a mob has been seen (clickable [go])" }, { "mobwhere <kw>", "same thing, shorter" }, { "snd area [text]", "area list with level ranges and start rooms" }, { "snd scan on|off", "record mobs from room descriptions as you go" }, { "" }, { "This is the data half of Search & Destroy. The quest/campaign" }, { "target automation was not ported - see PORTING.md." }, }) end end
aard.register("snd", "mob/area database from Search & Destroy", SD.cmd)
